appName.message: MeetMate — Live Meeting Q&A with Your Knowledge for Teams

appDesc.message: Live Teams Q&A with your own knowledge, custom shortcuts, end-of-meeting results, and BYOK. No bot or audio.

rephrasePrompt.message: You are native english teacher to help improve my oral english. Rephrase my message, provide explaination for change.

autoSuggestPrompt.message:
You are listening to a live meeting. New transcript chunk just arrived:

{chunk}

Full recent context:
{transcripts}

Decide ONE action and reply on a single line, prefixed with the keyword:
  SUGGEST: <≤25-word reply the user ({author}) could say next>
  RESEARCH: <one short fact or pointer relevant to current topic>
  SILENT
Output exactly one line. No quotes, no markdown.

minutesPrompt.message: The meeting just ended. Produce minutes in Markdown for {name}. Sections: Summary (3-5 bullets), Decisions, Action Items (owner if known), Open Questions. Use the transcripts.

quickPrompts.message:
Sum: Summarize the meeting.
?Respond: What can I respond now?
?Answer: Suggest a good answer for the last question
Actions: Highlight the action items coming out of this meeting?
Issues: Highlight the main challenges or issues discussed in the meeting.
Minutes: make a meeting minutes for the meeting

translateRecent.message: Translate recent captions to my preferred language

needTopup.message: Top up first!It's very very cheap to use.

shortcutDesc.message: a click away from AI for each line. Action with beginning '*' will be automatically triggered when leaving meeting.

enabledRephrasing.message: Enable after applying transcripts to recorded meeting.

enabledLanguageFlag.message: A button to flag language attention on a transcript.

enabledMeetingFlag.message: A button to flag content attention on a transcript.

assistantPreferencesDesc.message: Applied to every typed Ask and shortcut Ask. Grounding rules always take priority.

autoEndTitle.message: Run automatically when the meeting ends, then include the answer in the automatic download

resetShortcutsConfirm.message: Replace your shortcuts with the defaults?
